sun.name: Sun
sun.description: NASA: "The Sun's gravity holds the solar system together, keeping everything in its orbit."

mercury.name: Mercury
mercury.description: NASA: "Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system and the nearest to the Sun."

venus.name: Venus
venus.description: NASA: "Venus is the second planet from the Sun, and the sixth largest planet. It's the hottest planet in our solar system."

mars.name: Mars
mars.description: NASA: "Mars is one of the easiest planets to spot in the night sky -- it looks like a bright red point of light."

jupiter.name: Jupiter
jupiter.description: NASA: "Jupiter is the largest and oldest planet in our solar system."

saturn.name: Saturn
saturn.description: NASA: "Saturn is the sixth planet from the Sun and the second largest planet in our solar system."

uranus.name: Uranus
uranus.description: NASA: "Uranus is the seventh planet from the Sun, and the third largest planet in our solar system -- about four times wider than Earth."

neptune.name: Neptune
neptune.description: NASA: "Dark, cold and whipped by supersonic winds, giant Neptune is the eighth and most distant major planet orbiting our Sun."

pluto_barycenter.name: Pluto-Charon Barycenter
pluto_barycenter.description: Center of mass for Pluto-Charon binary planet system.

apophis.name: Apophis
apophis.description: A near-Earth asteroid that will make a close approach in 2029. Future OSIRIS-APEX target.
